scope: Field Collector required-consent withdrawal source regressions

pytest.audit_spool: Private temporary path under /private/tmp with mode 0700; removed after the run

new_cases.scenario: Known retired required-consent form has a grant at capture and a withdrawal by upload time.
new_cases.expected: HTTP 403, transaction rollback, no commit, and no private object write.

new_cases.scenario: Known retired required-consent record was captured under a grant, then withdrawn; a later grant is the current decision.
new_cases.expected: HTTP 403 because an intervening withdrawal remains disqualifying; rollback and no collection insert.

limits: Database decisions are mocked; this is API source regression evidence, not PostgreSQL-backed or browser acceptance.
The actual candidate Gateway/database and browser vault were not modified.
rollback: Revert the two test cases and their checklist/evidence updates; no service rebuild or database rollback is required.
